newsitem.title: USA: Cal Dive International Inc withdraws IPO.
newsitem.headline: Cal Dive International Inc withdraws IPO.

text.p: Houston-based Cal Dive International Inc said Friday that it withdrew its initial public offering, tentatively scheduled for November 11.
The company had planned to use the proceeds to fund the acquisition of J. Ray McDermott SA. The deal has also been put on hold.
A spokesperson for Cal Dive said that the company "would explore the possibility in six months" of reviving both the acquisition and the IPO.
Cal Dive provides sub-sea construction, inspection, maintenance and repair to the offshore gas and oil industry in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico.
The company had filed to offer 3.35 million shares at an estimated price range of $13 to $15 a share. Schroder Wertheim & Co was the lead underwriter for the cancelled deal.
